## Description and Rationale

I am Andreas Hadjinicolaou, a computer science student at the University of
Cyprus, entering my final year. I am entering on my own rather than as part of a
research group or a company.

I registered because taxi-out time is the kind of problem I want more practice
on: real operational data, a metric nobody can argue with, and a held-out period
that settles the question. Most public datasets I have worked with are either
toy problems or financial series where almost everything is noise. Airport
surface movements are neither, and the drivers are physical and schedulable
rather than random.

The other reason is how this challenge is run. Previous editions publish every
team's code and the write-ups go to an open journal, so the work stays useful
after the deadline. That is uncommon in data competitions and worth supporting.
